visual_logic.surface_detail: Leathery skin with 'Deep Teal' and 'Charcoal' mottling for low-light camouflage, mapped uniformly across its full horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the short, robust snout and the large eye orbit oriented parallel to the camera plane.

environment.water: Deep indigo-green water with diffused moonlight rays, balanced to keep the lateral outline completely measurable.
environment.biota: The heavy marine snow and floating 'Belemnitella' silhouettes are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, unobstructed silhouette line.

pose: The medium-sized mosasaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original vertical rising strike pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its robust snout, streamlined body, paddles, and down-turned tail fluke end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
